agent_assessment: Significant refactoring was completed across Phases 1-3. The .golangci.yml config is in place with funlen/cyclop/gocognit linters. All 8 targeted long files were split or reduced: orchestrator.go (1364->779), prerequisites.go (1003->313 + 3 platform files), handler.go (748->508 + bundle_staging.go 246), desktop_client.go (651->323 + pipeline 337), profiles/commands.go (831->563 + helpers 169 + types 108), deployments/commands.go (725->443 + deploy_desktop 288), signing/commands.go (621->527 + types 103). Both API and CLI compile cleanly and all 17 API test packages pass. However, golangci-lint still reports ~26 violations in API and ~6 in CLI (32 total), down from 151 original. Most remaining violations are gocognit in test files (15 of 26 API violations) and a few complex production functions (populateAssetMetadata, expandUIAssets, stageBundleArtifacts, discoverGPGKeys). Phase 4 (UI GuidedFlow.tsx split) was not started. Whether GCT score >= 70 depends on how GCT weights test-file violations vs production-code violations -- the production code quality improvement is substantial.
notes: 32 golangci-lint violations remain (down from 151 original). 15 of 26 API violations are in test files (gocognit).
Phase 4 (UI refactoring of GuidedFlow.tsx 513 lines) was not executed -- plan said to skip if Go refactoring alone reaches >= 70.
orchestrator_helpers.go (630 lines) is itself approaching the long_files threshold -- it contains 4 gocognit violations.
bundles/handler.go at 508 lines is below the 600-line threshold but stageBundleArtifacts still has gocognit 36.
Prerequisites split used prereqs_win/mac/lnx naming (not prerequisites_windows/macos/linux as planned) -- functionally equivalent.
ESLint CRITICAL comments status was not verified (UI phase not started).
